independence: Did not build the set, read review-opus.json or communicate with the Opus reviewer.
method: Read all 44 pairs and pilot README; compared cited local notes, including inbox drafts and approved/vouched distinctions. Primary-source spot checks are recorded per pair. text: In-kind dealing requires positions transferable under the relevant legal, clearing and fund arrangements. Where positions cannot be transferred, cash lets the fund establish or unwind the exposure itself.

pairs.question_review: Faithful procedural scope, avoiding unsupported total turnaround.
pairs.reference_review: Eligibility and notice/order distinction are right, but the clock summary omits restart lags, closure pauses and request formalities.
issues: Clock description omits important tolling/restart mechanics and expedited-request formalities.

fixes.text: File the factual/legal application; notice provides the hearing-request period, after which an order ordinarily issues unless a hearing is ordered. Expedited eligibility requires two substantially identical applications granted within three years before initial filing: same relief and conditions, only immaterial factual differences. Request expedited review prominently, supply comparison markups and a signed explanatory certification. Within 45 running days SEC issues notice or an ineligibility/additional-time response, not necessarily a final order. Modification requests pause the clock until day 14 after a compliant response amendment; unsolicited amendments until day 30 afterward. Irregular SEC office closures also pause it. A missing response amendment after 30 days causes deemed withdrawal.

text: Fixed creation/redemption charges cover processing, transfer and related operational costs. Variable charges can offset portfolio trading, brokerage, taxes and market-impact costs, particularly for cash, partial-cash or non-standard orders, protecting remaining shareholders.
